title: wslua: Handle DCE/RPC dissector functionality locally
description:
Move the functionality of dcerpc_init_from_handle() to wslua/wslua_dissector.c with the lua_handle_dcerpc_dissector() function.
This allows lua to not be dependent on specific dissector functionality.

commits_data.title: wslua: Handle DCE/RPC dissector functionality locally
commits_data.message:
wslua: Handle DCE/RPC dissector functionality locally

Move the functionality of dcerpc_init_from_handle() to wslua/wslua_dissector.c with the lua_handle_dcerpc_dissector() function.
This allows lua to not be dependent on specific dissector functionality.
